title: FlowGuard foreign validation record
description: What a schema owner says about a finding, and what the readiness gate is allowed to count. tools/fg_readiness.py reads this document to decide P1 (a third-party rebuild) and P4 (an owner-produced corpus). The shape is published here so the record can be produced without reading that source: before 2026-10-31 the requirements lived only in code, which is why P1 stayed at zero while the form looked fillable.

owner.description: A confirmation without a named person is a rumour with a timestamp.

schema.description: The schema or database this record is about.

executed_by.description: Who ran the tool. An execution alone supports nothing above tier 1.

owner_statement.description: The owner's sentence, quoted. Not our summary of it: a tidied quote is our statement.

verdict.description: Only confirmed and partially_correct count toward P1 in tools/fg_readiness.py; a refuted verdict is still the strongest evidence the loop works.

finding.description: The finding the owner speaks to: path_id, claim, our_evidence.

blind_evaluation.description: True when the owner built their own list before seeing ours. Without it the exercise measures agreement, not coverage.

ground_truth.description: An owner-produced expected list: produced_by, method, paths_expected, artifact.

our_result.description: Our numbers against that list: paths_found, missed, false_positives.
